note: Supplemental "depth and beauty" pack answering docs/DRAKANTOS_VISUAL_STUDY.md (table + priority list). NOT a full environment replacement and NOT wired into prototype/world -- integration (aliases.json / map generator / collision layer / the dynamic light pass itself) is game-dev work, out of game-art's write scope for this task. 0 PixelLab generations spent -- fully local Canvas.js pipeline.
palette: See palette.json in this same folder: depth-revised ground/foliage ramps, the new cliff ramp, reserved saturated accents, and a renderPreset object with the exact HSV multipliers a renderer can apply to existing forest-v4/v6/v7 ground art (DRAKANTOS_VISUAL_STUDY.md item #6).

groundVariants.note: NOT autotiled -- scatter at random/by noise per ground cell, same convention as forest_v4_tiles.js grassVariant()'s 6 variants, just on the darker depth ramp and with heavier per-tile decal baking (study item #1: "chao nunca e liso").

decals.note: Transparent-background overlays, NOT full tiles -- stamp these over ANY existing ground tile (forest-v4/v6/v7 included, not just ground_variant_*) at noise-picked positions and random rotation/flip for the "chao nunca e liso" effect. All collision: false.

ground.note: scatter in shaded/damp areas (near water, under dense canopy)
scatter sparsely after rain or near water; carries the reserved cyan sparkle accent

transitions.note: thin variant -- study item #8, grass invading a path/dirt tile edge
junco -- place on grass/shore cells directly bordering water
water-margin stone, flatter + wet sheen, distinct from forest-v6 props/rock_small.png (dry, no sheen)

cliff.note: Top surface uses the studio's existing 16-tile blob autotile convention (bitmask N*1+E*2+S*4+W*8, quarter-circle rounded corners -- same geometry as forest_v4_tiles.js path_blob/denseedge_blob and forest-v6's water_blob, extracted once into art/src/blob_autotile16.js). The vertical FACE below a south-facing top edge, its two outer corners, one inner corner and the ramp are NOT autotiled -- 5 discrete hand-placed pieces (same Wang-16-not-Wang-47-style tradeoff forest-v6/v7 documented for their own autotile). Placement rule: wherever a cliff_top_blob tile's S bit (bit 2) is 0, put the matching face/corner piece one cell below it on a separate "cliff-face" layer; put cliff_ramp.png at any single gap in that face row to let the player walk up.

facePieces.note: default face, use wherever the S bit of the top tile above is 0 and neither corner piece applies
convex corner, top plateau turns away to the left
convex corner, mirror of the left piece
concave corner where two face runs meet
walkable staircase -- place at any single gap in a face row to let the player climb the 1-level height

emissiveProps.note: tallest-impact single prop for study item #3; cluster 1-2 per clearing, not a carpet
small accent light, good near fern/tuft clutter clusters
landmark-scale beacon (path markers, arena entrances) -- widest radius of the three
Forest-path lamp post (wooden post, caged glass top) -- warm firelight, not the digital-theme accent used by data_crystal/data_totem. Place along paths/clearing edges for the night look.
Small crossed-log campfire, warm orange-red light, smaller radius than lantern_post -- camp/rest-point prop.

clutter.note: shorter/rounder than forest-v4 props tallGrassClump -- a satellite piece, not a replacement
bigger and mossier than forest-v4 fallenLog -- distinct asset, both can coexist

clusterExamples.note: Pre-built "nucleo + satelites" compositions (DRAKANTOS_VISUAL_STUDY.md item #5) showing how the clutter pieces above combine -- reference only, not mandatory; placement tooling can still place fern/tuft/etc. individually.
